summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of BELOTA GRC. Backend pytest: 30/33 passed. All non-AI endpoints (auth, CRM, diagnostic scoring, inventory sub-types, RoPA/RIPD/risks/actions/trainings/evidences/tickets CRUD, certificate rules, dashboards, audit, client scoping) work correctly. RoPA AI suggest works (~29s). 3 AI endpoints (diagnostic recommendations, RIPD generate, document generate) hit Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway around 100s — backend/LLM keeps processing but the ingress gateway times out, so users will see errors on longer AI generations. Frontend E2E via Playwright: login → dashboard → create company → diagnostic (100%) → overview → inventory (all 4 sub-types + add) → risks (add) → certificate (VERIFIED seal issued) → audit populated → logout — ALL PASS.

critical.issue: Returns 502 Bad Gateway from Cloudflare ingress (~100s timeout) for Claude Sonnet generations. Backend eventually completes but user sees error. Consider streaming, shorter prompts, background jobs, or a faster model.

minor.issue: Returns 404 before certificate is issued — frontend logs it as console error. Consider returning 200 with null or handling 404 silently in Certificate.jsx.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers.
Cookies are set with samesite='none'; secure=True which is fine for HTTPS preview but backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' unused — server hardcodes single FRONTEND_URL. Confirm intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Add DialogDescription for a11y.
'Sair' logout button has no data-testid (spec mentions logout not required but consistency helps automated testing).

integration_issues.issue: Ingress 502 after ~100s will surface as toast errors in UI. Users may retry and think feature is broken.

action_items: Address long AI request timeouts vs 100s Cloudflare ingress: use streaming/BackgroundTasks/async polling, or use a faster/smaller model for documents/RIPD/recommendations.
Silently handle 404 on GET /certificate in Certificate.jsx (no console error) since 'no cert yet' is expected state.
Add DialogDescription to Dialog components to remove a11y warnings.
Consider migrating deprecated FastAPI startup/shutdown events to lifespan handler.
Optional: add data-testid='logout-btn' to Sair button in Layout for test consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is monolithic (~900 lines) — split into routers (auth, companies, diagnostic, inventory, ai, certificate, dashboard) for maintainability.
AI endpoints do not stream and do not use BackgroundTasks; long responses will exceed reverse-proxy timeouts. Consider persisting a job and polling on the frontend.
Diagnostic AI recommendations use current company/domain gaps but does not persist the recommendations — user must re-generate every time.
CrudSection uses path='events' for Auditoria tab; ensure it never triggers POST/DELETE (canCreate=false ✓, but confirm no delete UI is exposed).
verify_password wraps bcrypt.checkpw in try/except and silently returns False — okay, but log the exception for auditability.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout expectation) — not implemented.
Cookies use samesite='none' unconditionally, which requires secure=True (ok on HTTPS but breaks local http dev).
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_/UITEST_ prefixed companies via admin session; one UITEST_Empresa_* remained after UI script (contains diagnostic 100%, risk, cert). Safe to leave or main agent can delete via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs full regression in ~150s. AI tests (TestAI) may sporadically 502 due to Cloudflare ingress ~100s timeout — not a backend bug. Frontend UI selectors all use data-testid per spec and work reliably. Auditoria tab uses CrudSection with path='events' — safe as canCreate=false. Certificate tab requires compliance_score>=70; set all 15 diagnostic answers to 'sim' to reach 100%.
rca of the issue: AI endpoints failing with 502: LLM generation via emergentintegrations→LiteLLM→Anthropic for long-form documents (RIPD, policy documents, multi-domain recommendations) takes >100s. Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress default idle timeout terminates the connection while backend continues processing. Mitigation: (a) reduce prompt/max_tokens, (b) switch to a lighter model, (c) implement background job pattern (POST enqueues, client polls /jobs/{id}), or (d) use SSE streaming so bytes flow before the timeout window.
